data.summary: The figures directory contains Python scripts and a Node.js utility for programmatically generating consistent SVG architecture diagrams, data models, and agent workflow visualizations for documentation.

file_insights.name: fig1_architecture.py
file_insights.summary: Generates Figure 1 SVG depicting the overall architecture of the data pipeline and diagnosis agent.
file_insights.source_summary: Initializes an Svg canvas and draws structured boxes, text labels, and directional arrows representing the system's architecture and orchestration flow.
file_insights.detailed_description: Defines the architectural overview figure (Figure 1) for the project, illustrating the data landing, orchestration, and diagnosis agents using a custom SVG builder.
responsibilities: Define data source and orchestrator boxes

file_insights.name: fig2_star.py
file_insights.summary: Generates Figure 2 SVG showcasing the star schema for orders and dimensions.
file_insights.source_summary: Creates an SVG graphic detailing the order items fact table alongside customer and product SCD2 dimensions.
file_insights.detailed_description: Generates Figure 2 illustrating the star schema model including fact and SCD2 dimension tables.
responsibilities: Display fact and dimension table relationships

file_insights.name: fig3_qa_agent.py
file_insights.summary: Generates Figure 3 SVG visualizing the QA agent process workflow.
file_insights.source_summary: Creates an SVG flowchart demonstrating user queries being processed through a LangGraph LLM loop and corresponding tool nodes.
file_insights.detailed_description: Generates Figure 3 illustrating the question-answering agent's loop and tool invocation flow.
responsibilities: Generate QA agent workflow diagram SVG
Represent LLM loops and tool nodes

file_insights.name: fig4_diag_agent.py
file_insights.summary: Generates Figure 4 SVG outlining the diagnostic agent execution steps.
file_insights.source_summary: Draws an SVG layout representing deterministic diagnostic steps and evidence collection prior to LLM synthesis.
file_insights.detailed_description: Generates Figure 4 detailing the diagnosis agent's sequential deterministic checks and synthesis steps.

file_insights.name: lib.py
file_insights.summary: Provides shared SVG generation utilities and styling palettes for rendering project figures.
file_insights.source_summary: Defines the Svg class with methods for drawing structured boxes, arrows, polygons, and text labels with a shared color scheme.
file_insights.detailed_description: Provides helper classes and styling functions (such as Svg boxes, arrows, text, and color palettes) to ensure consistent visual formatting across all architecture figures.
responsibilities: Provide styling palettes and coordinate helpers

file_insights.name: render.js
file_insights.summary: Node.js script to batch convert SVG architecture figures into PNG images.
file_insights.source_summary: Iterates over provided SVG file paths, reads their content, renders them to PNGs using Resvg, and writes the results.
file_insights.detailed_description: Automation script utilizing Resvg to convert SVG architectural figures into PNG image files.
responsibilities: Render SVGs to PNG format using Resvg
Write output PNG files to disk
